# cpanel_mysql_database (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel MySQL or MariaDB database and its privileged users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_database" "database" {
  name = "sc1john1234_database"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The database name, including the cPanel database prefix.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Set of String) The MySQL or MariaDB users that currently have access to the database.
